_evidence: ebx value cell of the menu item handlers 0x52928d / 0x5292c0 (and siblings): 0x539944 reads it as byte, word or dword by the item's width byte +0xd & 3 ('movzx eax,byte [ebx]' / 'movzx eax,word [ebx]' / 'mov eax,[ebx]', 3 -> eax 0) and 0x539a13 writes it back with the same width. 0x52928d: 'sub eax,1; jb' (value 0) then 'cmp eax,[esi+0x26]; jb' (limit); 0x5292c0: 'add eax,1; jb' (only the dword 0xffffffff carries) then 'cmp eax,[esi+0x26]; ja'. The first dword is drawn so all three widths see 0, 1, small, the byte/word maxima and the dword 0xffffffff / 0xfffffffe (random bytes give a full 0xffffffff almost never); bytes 4..7 random. Any value is valid: no index, pointer or divisor.
